# BLDR

> BLDR is the AI operating system and factory for enterprise and government, by Inova AI Solutions. It is the enterprise AI platform by Inova AI Solutions. It gives organisations ready-made assistants on day one and custom agents built for their systems, all governed in one place and running where they decide: hosted, in private cloud, on-premise or in-country.

Promise: Your AI. Your house. Your rules.

## What BLDR is: three layers
1. Assistants, out of the box: chat, voice and custom assistants, ready to switch on for staff and customers.
2. Your knowledge: each assistant is customised with the organisation's own RAG (documents, policies, records), answering with citations.
3. Custom agents: agents designed and built for one organisation and integrated into its systems, with model orchestration, approvals and a full audit trail. If the work runs through the organisation's systems, an agent for it can be built on BLDR.

Assistants answer and help. Agents do work inside systems and wait for a person to approve.

## The governed platform under every layer
- Gateway: every model call, tool call and data request is checked against the organisation's policy, logged and routed only to approved models.
- Controls: approvals before action, human takeover, audit trail, role-based access and tenant boundaries, policy checks before execution, model routing by sensitivity and cost.
- Connectors include SAP Ariba (SLP and Sourcing), SAP ERP over RFC and on-prem ERPs over SQL. Built for the systems you already run.
- Deployment: hosted, private cloud, on-premise, in-country, dedicated and white-label.

## Use cases
Procurement, sales, marketing, HR, finance, customer service (chat and voice), IT, legal and compliance. Across government, financial services, healthcare, education, telecom, energy and retail.

## Proof
- An enterprise deployment across SAP Ariba, SAP ERP and an on-prem ERP is underway in Saudi Arabia.
- Five agent patterns in that deployment: document checks with OCR, Arabic-to-English master data, vendor scoring and bid-manipulation detection, tender knowledge search, invoice support.
- Reference enterprise build: 16 weeks across three systems.
- Console figures shown on the site (99.99% uptime, 312 agents, 24 workflows a day) are sample console data, not a named client's results.

## Trust posture
- Alignment with ISO 27001, SOC 2 readiness, GDPR, Australia's Privacy Act, Saudi PDPL and NCA controls, sovereign-ready. Alignment and readiness, not certification; a certification roadmap is available in the security pack.

## Answers
- What comes out of the box? Chat, voice and custom assistants, customised with your own knowledge.
- Can BLDR build a custom agent for us? Yes; Inova designs, integrates and governs it with your team.
- Where do BLDR's models run? The customer chooses: hosted or in their own infrastructure. Every model call goes through the BLDR gateway, governed by the customer's policy. Model residency is confirmed per deployment.
- Does BLDR send data to OpenAI or Anthropic? Only if the customer's policy allows it, and then through the gateway: logged, filtered and approved by the customer's rules.
- Arabic and English: yes, Arabic-first delivery.

## How to start
Briefing, discovery workshop, proof of value on one back-office workflow, then a dedicated deployment. A procurement pack (security answers, data processing terms, rate card, partner routes) comes with it.
